#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct FastReader {
    std::stringstream ss;
    std::string line;
    std::istringstream iss;

    FastReader() {
        std::cin.tie(nullptr);
        std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    }

    std::string next() {
        std::string s;
        while (!(iss >> s)) {
            if (!std::getline(std::cin, line))
                return "";
            iss.clear();
            iss.str(line);
        }
        return s;
    }

    int nextInt() { return std::stoi(next()); }
    long long nextLong() { return std::stoll(next()); }
    double nextDouble() { return std::stod(next()); }
    std::string nextLine() {
        std::getline(std::cin, line);
        return line;
    }
};

long long dp[][25][11];
bool visited[100000][25][11]; // optional, to optimize memoization if needed
int mod = 998244353;

std::vector<long long> bit, bit1;
std::unordered_map<int,int> map;

long long go(const std::vector<char> &A, int i, int pv, int v) {
    if(i == (int)A.size()) {
        return (pv == 0) ? 1 : 0;
    }
    if(dp[i][pv][v] != -1) {
        return dp[i][pv][v];
    }
    long long ans = 0;
    if(A[i] == '_') {
        for(int j=0; j<=9; ++j) {
            if(i==0 && j==0) continue;
            int y = (pv*10 + j) % 25;
            ans += go(A, i+1, y, v);
        }
    } else if (A[i] == 'X') {
        if(v != 10) {
            ans += go(A, i+1, (pv*10 + v) % 25, v);
        } else {
            for(int j=0; j<=9; ++j) {
                if(i==0 && j==0) continue;
                int y= (pv*10 + j) % 25;
                ans += go(A, i+1, y, j);
            }
        }
    } else {
        int digit = A[i] - '0';
        ans += go(A, i+1, (pv*10 + digit) % 25, v);
    }
    return dp[i][pv][v] = ans;
}

int main() {
    FastReader sc;
    int t=1;
    while(t-- > 0) {
        std::string s_str = sc.next();
        std::vector<char> A(s_str.begin(), s_str.end());
        if(A.size() == 1 && A[0] == '0') {
            std::cout << "1\n";
            return 0;
        }
        if(A[0] == '0') {
            std::cout << "0\n";
            return 0;
        }
        if(A.size() == 1) {
            if(A[0]=='X' || A[0]=='_') {
                std::cout << "1\n";
                return 0;
            }
        }
        memset(dp, -1, sizeof(dp));
        std::cout << go(A, 0, 0, 10) << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
